verdict.rationale: Otter ships a built-in assistant, Otter AI Chat, which searches meetings and connected apps to answer questions and help create follow-ups, reports, and content, and can also query Salesforce and HubSpot. Related built-in AI features auto-generate follow-up emails and pre-meeting briefings. The evidence shows drafting and Q&A rather than the assistant itself carrying out multi-step tasks or actions in other tools; pushes to Jira, Zendesk and similar tools are described as automatic integrations, not as tasks delegated to the chat. Missing for 10: evidence that AI Chat performs actions or multi-step delegated tasks, in-depth documentation of the assistant's capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration of AI Chat.
